context:

The additive `refresh_session` hook re-applies each arm's ClickHouse adapter session and settings pack before each power round. Evidence in runs/harness-session-reapply-20261010/: 30/30 timed executions carried the configured session; cell B (seed 43, 15 rounds, Q13-only) passed A/A with G 0.9782 and no answer mismatches; harness suite 97 passed; full fast suite 37,076 passed, 26 skipped. `gh pr checks 2880 --required` reports core, docs, explorer, landing, oracle-review, results-data, and tooling all pass.

The cell-B `summary.md` records host macOS-27.0.1, Mocker 0.7.2, and Apple Container CLI 1.1.0. `docs/operations/uat-framework.md:301` documents Mocker validation on macOS 26 only. The observed cell is therefore not supported-platform calibration evidence under current documentation. Rerun the Q13 A/A on Linux/Docker or a documented, validated Apple Container path before finishing. The full 22-query post-fix verdict cell remains with item 25; it is not an F1 acceptance item.
